# §2 Introduction (Scope, Key Features)

I3C is backward compatible with legacy I2C target devices on the same bus,
allowing a mixed bus of I3C and I2C devices. Dynamic Address Assignment (DAA)
lets the controller assign a 7-bit dynamic address to each target at bus
initialization, replacing static I2C addressing.

The push-pull SDR mode raises the effective data rate well beyond I2C's
open-drain signaling.
